queer_characters.name: Rinko
queer_characters.notes: Described as a transgender woman who serves as a supportive maternal figure to Tomo, presented in a warm found-family light rather than as tragedy or spectacle.

contributor_notes: Source text confirms Rinko as a transgender woman and central maternal figure. Makio (her partner) is not given a stated identity in the source, so he was not tagged. Director Naoko Ogigami's own identity is not stated in the source. child-abuse trigger reflects Tomo being neglected and abandoned by her mother. Maintainer should verify subtitle/audio language availability and check whether the film depicts transphobia deserving an additional trigger warning.
